answer: Trace each new agent's entry bond to its funding root, then make the k-th identity drawing on one capital source post a bond scaling as k-squared. A lone honest operator pays once, flat; a sybil farm bankrolled from a single treasury hits a karst of hidden sinkholes where its reserves quadratically drain away. Clones freeze out like a barren tundra, and only genuinely independent capital survives to the next dawn of settlement.
